subject: Follow-up: demo & technical deep-dive — rotating time slots
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@skyline.io>, Jamie Torres <jamie.t@skyline.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: demo & technical deep-dive — rotating time slots

Hi Alex / Jamie,

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Goal: integrate Redwood inference for low-latency chat & embeddings in your user-search product.
- Primary constraints: P95 latency under 250ms, SOC2 evidence for initial pilots, and predictable monthly committed capacity.
- Stakeholders: Alex (product owner), Jamie (infra/ops), possible inclusion of your security lead before procurement.

Next steps I mentioned: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive + demo (runtime, quantization options, and deployment modes). To make scheduling easier for your global team, I propose rotating the meeting time each week so the burden is shared across US / EU / APAC participants. Example rotation (we can adjust):

Week A — US-friendly
- Tue 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 GMT (good for US mornings & EU late afternoon)

Week B — EU-friendly
- Wed 14:00 CET / 13:00 GMT / 08:00 ET (midday EU)

Week C — APAC-friendly
- Thu 10:00 SGT / 03:00 GMT / Wed 19:00 PT (APAC morning)

If you'd prefer concrete first dates, I can propose:
- First demo (US-friendly): Wed, Dec 8, 2026 — 09:00 PT / 17:00 GMT

Please let me know which rotation approach you prefer and who from your side should attend the deep-dive (tech leads, security, procurement). If it helps, grab a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30min?owner=marissa — I can then send a calendar invite for the confirmed slot.

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes & open questions).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@skyline.io>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up: demo & technical deep-dive — rotating time slots

Thanks Marissa — great notes. A couple quick items from our side:
- We like the rotating approach. For the first deep-dive, our core engineering + infra folks (including my lead, Priya, and our security contact) need to be present. Can we lock a time that works for both EU and US?
- APAC will have limited overlap; if you do an APAC-friendly slot later, our Singapore PM may join asynchronously.

For the Dec 8th suggestion — I can do Wed Dec 8 at 17:00 GMT (that works for the London folks). One ask: can you include a short agenda (45–60 min) that includes: 1) runtime architecture overview, 2) integration patterns (API vs private), 3) perf numbers & KV cache behavior, 4) initial rollout plan?

Also, please loop in your security point-of-contact so we can schedule a separate 30-minute review with our security team (SOC2, data residency questions).

Alex
Alex Nguyen
Product Lead, Search 
Skyline.io
alex@skyline.io | +44 7700 900123
